text: Colm - knee op @ St Vincent's Thurs 6 Nov 2026, 7am check-in. text him wed night, gd luck etc
dentist moved to Tues at 4.15. bring old x-rays
Zara's gig @ Whelan's Sat - doors 8pm. me + Rahul going, already got tix
Lars back home after 3 nights in hosp. v tired, sleeping loads. wife Simone off work all wk to mind him
Adriana / half marathon / Sun 9 Nov 2026 @ 9am. 1st one ever, bricking it. dont forget to text her sat eve
car NCT - 14 Jan 2027, 10.30am @ Deansgrange. renew tax before that
Tobi said his sister Esme got into the Royal Academy - starts Sept 2027. delighted for her
Jun - hip replacement went fine yest. out by Fri hopefully. pop in w/ grapes + crossword book
school play cancelled - Ryan's little one had a part, now not happening til spring. he's gutted
Damian & Shreya - both running Dublin marathon Sun 26 Oct. train together every Tues/Thurs 6am
Asha's mum - biopsy results due Mon morning. Asha v anxious, not sleeping. check in w/ her Mon aft
Elif = huge Galatasaray fan. season ticket holder, goes back to Istanbul for derby matches
Amir - 5-a-side final tmrw night 8pm. ask how it went thurs
collect prescription / post office / pay gas bill before Fri
Gemma Hughes (Gem) - new physio, works @ Beacon. recommended her to Connor for his shoulder

Valentina's cello recital - 2 November 2026, 7.30pm, NCH John Field Room. she's nervous, 1st solo since uni & her teacher will be there. playing Elgar + something Spanish she wouldn't name. her parents flying in from Bogotá the day before. bring flowers? ask Francesca if she wants a lift - she's near Ranelagh so easy pickup on the way. dinner after maybe, somewhere near Earlsfort Tce
Luis broke his wrist @ rugby sat. cast for 6 wks. can't drive so his gf Lin doing school runs
me - eye test Weds 12th at half 9, then work from home rest of day

Tomás and Dorota's band playing Workman's Club Fri 21 Nov - on at 9.30, support act at 8. first gig w/ new drummer after the old one moved to Berlin. they've been rehearsing every night, Dorota says they're tight now. new EP out same wk. must book tix before they sell out - get 4, ask Zara + Connor
Claire's dad - triple bypass sched for March 2027. she's flying back to Cork for it. ask her nearer the time how he's doing
Anders - cat Pickle had op on her paw, stitches out next Wed. he was in bits about it
Aidan - driving test the 18th at 2pm. 3rd attempt. totally stressed. remind me to text him gd luck that morning
Eva mentioned Ximena wd love tix to Hozier - he's playing 3Arena May 2027. bday's around then. could go halves w/ Eva
bins out tonight - recycling wk
Rahul - swimming gala w/ his twins Sat morning, 10am @ National Aquatic. they're 9. he's coaching too

Zeynep - post-op check Fri at 11. hysterectomy recovery slow, lots of pain still, can't do stairs. her partner Ava v worried, juggling work + the kids on her own. Ava's mum coming up from Wexford next wk to help. need to drop dinners over this wk - lasagne Tues, soup Thurs. Z vegetarian, no mushrooms
Colm's op done. surgeon happy. physio starts 2 wks. follow up next wk re how first session went

Francesca - Bianchi side of family all coming over for her nonna's 90th, 15 Dec 2026. huge party @ Castleknock hotel, 7pm, 120 ppl. her cousin Simone flying in from Milan, uncle Luis doing a speech. nonna has no idea about the Italian relatives, total surprise. Fran stressed out of her mind organising it all w/ her brother. I'm on music. offer to help w/ table plan
Connor - shoulder MRI Mon 8am. waited 5 months for it
book NCT / renew passport (exp. Feb 2027!) / sort insurance before 30 Nov
Lin & Luis - anniversary Sat. 10 yrs. going to Kerry for long wknd
Simone's choir competition in Cork, 22 Nov 2026 at 3pm. they made the national final. Lars driving her down
Adriana smashed it - 1:58 for the half marathon. first sub 2. buy her a pint thurs
Jun's daughter Shreya started at TU Dublin - engineering. loving it so far

Dr Okafor - consultant appt moved to 4 Dec 2026, 2.40pm (was 20 Nov). bring the blood results + list of meds + the diary of symptoms. ask about the scan & whether the new tablets are why I'm so tired. book the morning off, parking is a nightmare there so get the Luas. bloods again 2 wks before
Elif's play opens Thurs 13 Nov @ Smock Alley - 8pm. she plays the mother. tix €18. get 2

Ryan - redundancy confirmed. last day 31 Dec 2026. 14 yrs there, whole dept gone. putting brave face on but stressed re mortgage, & his wife Eva only part time since the baby. he's applying for a few roles, interview w/ a fintech crowd Weds 5 Nov at 10am. ring him this wk, maybe mention Rahul's company is hiring
Damian - got the knee scan back, torn meniscus. surgery prob Jan 2027. out of the marathon obvs. pulled out yest
gym membership - cancel before renewal 1 Nov
Tobi (Tobs) - DJing @ Opium Fri 31 Oct. Halloween set. says it's his biggest gig yet
Asha's mum all clear!! biopsy benign. Asha so relieved. send her a msg tonight
Gemma - mentioned she's been on about getting a new running watch. Garmin Forerunner. xmas idea
Zara - tonsils out Mon 10 Nov, overnight @ Mater. her bf Aidan off work to mind her. soup + ice pops. she's dreading it
Amir's team lost final on pens. he's raging. dad Mr Usman was there filming
Valentina - recital went really well apparently. Francesca said standing ovation. ask her about the encore piece when I see her

Anders + Eva doing Dublin to Galway cycle 7 June 2027, leaving 6am from Phoenix Park. raising money for Beaumont after his stroke last yr - he says the stroke unit basically saved his life. training most Sundays, 80km+ now. target €5k, at about €2k. donate when payday comes & share the link around work
Ximena - flat viewing tmrw at 6pm in Phibsboro. 3rd one this wk
me - flu jab @ pharmacy, Sat morning. walk-in, no appt needed

Esme's brother Tomás in hosp - appendix out last night, emergency, went in at 2am w/ pains. ok now but sore, nearly burst apparently. out maybe Thurs, then 2 wks off work. her mum staying up there. he was meant to play the cup match Sat, def out now, raging about it. don't forget to text Tomás tmrw
Dorota Wang - piano grade 8 exam 3 Dec 2026, 10am. practising 3 hrs a day. v nervous re sight reading. wish her luck the day before
Connor's MRI - nothing torn, just inflammation. relief. physio 2x a wk now
Claire coeliac + veggie. Lars allergic to nuts. for dinner party on the 29th
Rahul's twins both medalled at the gala Sat. the older one gold in 50m back. he sent vids
Shreya - tennis club tournament Sat 15 Nov at 1pm, in the semis. Jun going to watch
drop suit to dry cleaners Mon morning, pick up Thurs eve. need it for 21st
Aidan passed!! 3rd time lucky. gonna drive up to see his nan in Sligo at Xmas. send congrats

Lars - stent fitted 20 Oct after the chest pains at work, ambulance & all. follow-up angiogram Jan 2027, prob 2nd wk. Simone says he's grumpy, bored stiff at home, not allowed lift anything. Their son Anders is coming home from Oslo Fri to help. I should call over Sunday afternoon w/ the papers
Colm (Colmy) said Gemma & Damian's wedding is off. not saying more. awkward
Francesca - started new job @ Accenture Mon. hates the commute already. ask how 1st wk went fri
Elif & Zeynep - going to see Fontaines DC in Paris 14 March 2027 @ 9pm. flights booked. Elif's bday wkend. dog Bruno going to Ava's
